head_coach.name: Néstor Lorenzo
head_coach.play_style_summary: Lorenzo employs a quick-transition style focusing on wing pace, verticality, and high-energy pressing. Midfield control is emphasized with a playmaker pulling the strings to orchestrate attacks while maintaining defensive discipline in a structured block.

key_players.name: Luis Díaz
key_players.performance_stats: Averaged a 7.75 FotMob rating in the 2025/2026 Bundesliga season with Bayern Munich. Known for explosive dribbling, rapid transitions, and elite work rate off the ball.

key_players.name: Richard Ríos
key_players.performance_stats: Averaged a 7.34 FotMob rating in the 2025/2026 season for SL Benfica. Excelled in midfield duels, interception, and linking defense to attack via long-range diagonal passes.

key_players.name: Daniel Muñoz
key_players.performance_stats: Averaged a 7.15 FotMob rating during the 2025/2026 season for Crystal Palace. Distinguished by his high work rate, overlapping runs, and strong tackle completion rate.
